_source.remarks.text.1: 注意 1：本接口仅客户端有效，在浏览器环境内调用将始终 `throw Error`
_source.remarks.text.2: 注意 2：本接口需要使用者启用扩展的外部交互权限，如若未启用将始终 `throw Error`

title: In file system in create folder
remarks.text.1: Note 1: This API is only valid for clients. Calling it in a browser environment will always `throw Error`
